subject: Post-demo next steps: procurement route, marketplace option, and billing start
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo next steps: procurement route, marketplace option, and billing start

Hi Alice — great demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on procurement + trial->paid timing: 

Recap from today's demo:
- ClearWave will run a 3-week technical trial (app integration + traffic ramp).
- Primary success signals: sustained 95th pctl latency < 200ms, LLM accuracy on your evaluation set >= 85% (we have your eval set), and steady usage >= 120k tokens/day for 48+ hours.

Procurement / commercial options (please confirm which you prefer):
1) Purchase Order (PO) / Net30 (typical for enterprise). Procurement lead: procurement@clearwave.ai. Timeline: 2–3 weeks on our side for legal + billing onboarding.
2) Corporate card (fastest): can enable billing immediately; good for avoiding downtime between trial and PO completion.
3) Cloud marketplace listing: often fastest path to billing activation (marketplace handles vendor onboarding) — can be <72 hours depending on the marketplace.

Questions for you:
- Which procurement path do you want us to prioritize (PO vs card vs marketplace)?
- If PO, please share the PO template and any internal vendor onboarding checklist (SOC 2 evidence, W-9, legal contact).
- Confirm target billing start date if trial goes green (we tentatively suggested Nov 16).

Attachments: Redwood-SOW-template-v1.pdf (sample), PoC-plan-clearwave.xlsx (timeline & success criteria).

Next steps (proposed):
- You confirm procurement path + procurement contact (today).
- If marketplace: we submit listing and target activation within 48–72 hours.
- If PO: we exchange PO template and Redwood legal will begin onboarding; recommend temporary card authorization to avoid gap.

Happy to hop on a 15-min call with procurement if helpful.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood-SOW-template-v1.pdf; PoC-plan-clearwave.xlsx

From: Alice Chen <alice@clearwave.ai>

Subject: Re: Post-demo next steps: procurement route, marketplace option, and billing start

Thanks, Kimberly — appreciate the clear recap. A few quick answers and some requests from procurement: 

- Procurement path: priority is PO / Net30. Procurement have a standard vendor onboarding and require SOC 2 Type II evidence, W-9, and our internal security questionnaire completed. I attached our PO template for your legal & finance teams.
- Marketplace: we are open to marketplace if it truly accelerates onboarding — can you share which marketplace and whether Net30 invoices are supported?
- Billing start: if the trial passes the gates, we would plan to start billing Nov 16. If PO processing delays, we could temporarily put billing on a corporate card for the initial month.

Procurement asks: 
- Can Redwood provide a SOC 2 report and contact for vendor onboarding?
- Example invoice with Net30 terms?

I attached our PO template (clearwave_po_template.docx). Looping in Jeff (Finance) and procurement mailbox.

— Alice
Alice Chen
Director, Platform Partnerships | ClearWave AI
alice@clearwave.ai

Subject: Re: Post-demo next steps: procurement route, marketplace option, and billing start

Hi Alice / team — thanks for the quick reply and for sharing the PO template. A few concrete notes from our side: 

1) Marketplace option: we are listed on CloudVendor Marketplace (link below). Marketplace onboarding often reduces vendor paperwork overhead and allows billing activation faster than a manual PO path. However, invoice terms on marketplaces vary — many only support standard net terms through marketplace invoicing, so we would confirm Net30 availability once you pick that path. Marketplace link: https://marketplace.cloudvendor.com/redwood-inference-listing

2) SOC 2 / onboarding materials: attached is our SOC 2 summary and vendor onboarding pack (we will send the full report via secure share once an NDA is in place). Contact for security/vendor onboarding: security@redwood.com.

3) Example invoice: drafting an example Net30 invoice and sample SOW for ClearWave now; will send via DocuSign preview so your finance team can confirm fields match your AP process.

4) Trial->paid timing: Nov 16 start looks good as a target. If procurement moves slower, our recommended fallback is to enable a corporate-card billing method for the first billing cycle to avoid disruption. We can set a credit limit and auto-switch once the PO is active.

Next steps (I'll own):
- Share SOC 2 summary + onboarding pack (attached).
- Create example invoice + DocuSign preview (expected by EOD).
- If you want, I can schedule a 20-min call with procurement + our finance lead to accelerate PO onboarding.

Thanks — looping Marissa (SE) and Dylan (AE backup) to support technical success gating and billing ops respectively.

Best,
Kimberly

Attachments: Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf; Redwood-SOW-template-v1.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: ClearWave procurement path — suggested playbook

Kim / Dylan — internal summary and recommended sequence to keep this deal moving without gaps. Posting here so we have a shared playbook to reference (I will also add to the HubSpot deal notes).

Deal: ClearWave AI (RW-2026-1447) — target billing start Nov 16 if trial passes.

Recommended plan:
- Day 0 (Nov 3): Kimber sends SOC2 + sample invoice (done).
- Day 0–2: Ask ClearWave to confirm marketplace vs PO. If marketplace chosen, we submit listing fast-track and set expectation: activation within 48–72 hours.
- If PO chosen: 
  * Kimberly / Legal to accept PO template and return any redlines within 48 hrs.
  * Procurement onboarding (SOC2 exchange, W-9) — expect 7–14 business days depending on customer procurement.
  * To avoid downtime, enable corporate-card billing for first month (Finance ops can provision a card hold and auto-switch when PO is active).

Success gating (what marissa will validate during trial):
- Integration test (auth, tokenization) — pass
- 95th pctl latency < 200ms at stated load — pass
- Evaluation score >= 85% on provided eval set — pass
- Usage >= 120k tokens/day for at least 48 hours — pass

Owner assignments:
- Commercial owner: Kimberly Park (primary)
- SE / technical owner: Marissa Cole
- Billing ops / finance contact: Dylan Brooks

Related links: HubSpot deal note and DocuSign preview will be attached to deal. I also added the PoC timeline to the shared drive link in the deal.

I recommend we offer the marketplace activation path as the preferred route (fastest), with PO as the canonical contract. Kimberly — if you get commit to marketplace, I'll open the SE checklist and prep the trial handover doc for Nov 9 (mid-trial check).

-Marissa
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Kimberly / team — thanks for the quick follow-ups and the SOC2 summary. We discussed with procurement and finance and want to proceed with the marketplace route to avoid delays. A few specifics: 

- Marketplace chosen: CloudVendor Marketplace. Jeff (cc) confirms Net30 is preferred, but marketplace activation + our AP team will accept marketplace invoices.
- We will still submit a formal PO in parallel for the commercial record; procurement will email a PO after marketplace activation.
- Billing start: please plan to enable billing Nov 16 if trial gates are green. If there is any activation lag, we will allow an initial corporate-card payment for the first invoice and then switch to PO terms.

Procurement contact for the PO: procurement@clearwave.ai (cc). I attached the PO template earlier. Please send the DocuSign preview and example invoice when ready.

Looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

— Alice
